# Keys and locks
Doors, chests and cabinets with a lock installed can be locked and unlocked with a matching key.
## Shape
Every key and lock has a [color=yellow]shape[/color] - a sequence of teeth. Each tooth has a height from 1 to 5, and the number of teeth defines the [color=yellow]complexity[/color]. A key opens a lock only if their shapes [color=yellow]match exactly[/color]. A key ring picks the matching key from the ones on it by itself.
To see the shape, examine a key or a portable lock while holding it in your hands.
## Installing a lock
A portable lock can be installed into a door or a chest by simply using it on them.
## Lockpicking
A lock can be opened without a key using a lockpick.
## Forges
The main way to work with keys and locks is two automatic forges.
- The [color=yellow]key forge[/color] makes keys. - The [color=yellow]lock forge[/color] makes portable locks.
Each key or lock costs [color=yellow]1 iron bar[/color].
